# Test fixtures

Everything here is synthetic or comes from a GPL-3.0 project, never from a game
install.

| File                               | Origin                                                                                    |
| ---------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `bmstwo/EZ2_TEMPLATE.bmson`        | BmsTWO (`Roganis/BmsTWO`, GPL-3.0), the EZ2 starting template, copied unchanged           |
| `synthetic/StreetMix.gds`          | written by hand in the format of EZ2PORT's `docs/gds-slots.md`                            |
| `synthetic/STYLE_StreetMix0_0.pvi` | written by hand in the format EZ2PORT's `ez2/pvi.c` reads                                 |
| `synthetic/publish-golden.json`    | hashes of EZ2BMS's own publish output for seeded random charts (`publish-golden.test.ts`) |
